title: Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority Amendment (Enhancing Australia's Anti-Doping Capability) Bill 2019
short_title: Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority Amendment (Enhancing Australia's Anti-Doping Capability) Bill 2019
portfolio: Regional Services, Sport, Local Government and Decentralisation

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would help the Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority (ASADA) handle more complex doping threats.
It would make changes to the ASADA Act based on recommendations from the Wood Review, including streamlining the early part of the doping violation process.
The bill would also extend legal protection to people carrying out anti-doping rule violation functions and strengthen ASADA's disclosure notice powers.
changes: Streamline the early stage of the anti-doping rule violation process.
Extend legal protection to additional people performing anti-doping rule violation functions.
Improve how ASADA and National Sporting Organisations share information by increasing legal protections for that information.
summary.affected: The Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority, National Sporting Organisations, and people exercising anti-doping rule violation functions.
